description:
It has already been a year since their marriage.
Now, the time has come. The time to let him go.

Anita, who had nowhere to go after her family fell and her father went missing. And Lancelot, who was her longtime friend and her only salvation.

She thought they had been a happy married life in their own way. They were considerate of each other.

Because she had tried to understand him again. The more she looked back, the more she realized how much kindness she owed Lancelot. So now, it was Anita’s turn to step aside: for Lancelot and his new lover.
